chunks: And al-Sadiq عليه السلام would apply depilatory paste to his armpits in the bathhouse and say:
Plucking the armpit weakens the shoulders, causes feebleness, and weakens the eyesight.

key_terms.الصَّادِقُ: Imam Ja'far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq عليه السلام

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about plucking armpit hair?
ai.summary: This report describes a practice of Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام regarding personal cleanliness in the bathhouse. It conveys that using depilatory paste on the armpits was preferred over plucking, which he said weakens the shoulders and the eyesight.
